edm:ProvidedCHO.dc:title: Enhancing metadata for inclusive research on entrenched disadvantage
edm:ProvidedCHO.dc:description: This funding award supports a project aimed at improving metadata practices to facilitate inclusive research on issues of entrenched disadvantage. The project focuses on creating robust, standardized metadata that accurately represents diverse populations and contexts.
edm:ProvidedCHO.dc:creator: The Research Trust
